questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, it signals the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to bicycles crossing the road ahead. Slow down and watch for cyclists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. The arrow indicates the location of the crossing. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When a lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger, the group should form a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete halt and wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help communicate with other riders. When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells the group to increase speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm down and swings it downward to their side, this hand signal tells the group to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left turns from both directions. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane will exit the freeway. You must either exit or change lanes to stay on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign tells you a traffic light is coming up. Be prepared to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points it upward, this hand signal means they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that from this lane, you can either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you there is a sharp turn coming. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is becoming a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider.
